name: amk-animation
description: Animação AMK SaaS (mecânica SaaS Animation Style Neutral Flow) — scaffold do kit

scripts.still: remotion still AmkStage out/still.png --frame=60 --browser-executable="/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser"
scripts.frames: remotion render AmkStage out/frames --sequence --image-format=jpeg --timeout=120000 --browser-executable="/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser" --concurrency=1
scripts.render: remotion render AmkStage out/amk.mp4 --timeout=120000 --browser-executable="/Applications/Brave Browser.app/Contents/MacOS/Brave Browser" --concurrency=1
